info.title: AnChain.AI Wallet Insights API (Beta)
info.description:
**Request a test API key:** [info@anchain.ai](mailto:info@anchain.ai)

**This beta is available for client testing.** Use it to screen Ethereum withdrawal destinations for potential fraud before releasing funds. Send the same two fields, `blockchain` and `address`, to either endpoint. Both accept GET query parameters or a POST JSON body.

get.description: Send the withdrawal destination as the address. Use ETH for Ethereum mainnet. Read the HTTP status separately from the JSON body. HTTP 200 with body `404` means 404 full days since the earliest observed activity. HTTP 404 with body `"not_found"` means no age is available. HTTP 503 with body `"unknown"` means the age is temporarily unavailable. Apply an under-three-days rule only to HTTP 200 bodies of `0`, `1`, or `2`.

200.description: Full days since the earliest observed Ethereum activity. The response body is one integer.

Cache-Control.description: Do not store this response in an HTTP cache.

X-Wallet-Age-Coverage.description: Blockchain covered by the age result.

X-Wallet-Age-Quality.description: The age is a lower bound. Earlier activity may exist.

X-Wallet-Age-Cache.description: Whether this response reused a previous observation.

X-Wallet-Age-Finalized.description: Whether the observed activity is finalized.

X-Wallet-Age-Evidence.description: Evidence category for the returned age.

X-Wallet-Age-Sources.description: Number of sources counted for this response. A zero count can accompany a valid age.

get.summary: Review balances, account activity and risk labels
get.description: Send the same ETH address you used for the age check. Use ETH and the selected USDC, USDT and DAI balances, account nonce, code profile and available labels as context for a withdrawal review. Read status and components before using individual fields. HTTP 200 can include a partial result. A missing balance or label is unknown. A large balance alone does not establish that a withdrawal is authorized.

blockchain.description: Use ETH for Ethereum mainnet. Accepted EVM aliases, including Polygon, also return Ethereum activity only.

address.description: An Ethereum address starting with 0x followed by 40 hexadecimal characters. Uppercase and lowercase hexadecimal digits are accepted.

WalletAgeDays.description: Number of full days since the earliest observed Ethereum activity. Zero means activity was observed less than 24 hours ago. An unknown age is returned as an error.

blockchain.description: Use ETH, ethereum, or eth-mainnet. Values are case-insensitive. This endpoint covers Ethereum mainnet.

address.description: An Ethereum address starting with 0x followed by 40 hexadecimal characters. Uppercase and lowercase hexadecimal digits are accepted.

InsightsBlock.description: Ethereum block for the reported balances, nonce and code profile. Use its timestamp to check when these values applied.

balanceRaw.description: Exact integer in raw units, encoded as a decimal string. Null means unavailable, never an assumed zero.

InsightsTokenBalance.description: Balance for USDC, USDT or DAI on Ethereum. Divide balanceRaw by 10 raised to decimals to display the token amount.

InsightsCodeProfile.description: Indicates whether the address has empty, delegated or contract code. Use this to interpret the account type. It does not establish ownership.

InsightsLabel.description: Category and supporting information for review. An association alone does not establish fraud.

checkedAt.description: UTC ISO timestamp, or null when unavailable.

providerVerdictTime.description: Time associated with the label, when available.

InsightsRiskLabels.description: Read status before using labels. Missing or empty labels do not establish that the destination is safe.

capturedAt.description: UTC ISO timestamp, or null when unavailable.

expiresAt.description: UTC ISO timestamp, or null when unavailable.

InsightsCacheComponent.description: Use capturedAt to see when this part of the result was observed. A null timestamp means it is unavailable.

checkedAt.description: UTC ISO timestamp, or null when unavailable.

balanceRaw.description: Exact integer in raw units, encoded as a decimal string. Null means unavailable, never an assumed zero.

accountNonce.description: Account nonce as a decimal string, or null if unknown. Use it as account context. It is not a count of all transfers.

WalletInsightsResponse.description: Check status and components before using balances, account information or labels. For observed wallet age, call /walletAgeDays.
